_global_note: This is the global MCP configuration (~/.claude/.mcp.json). Servers marked 'always-active' are enabled for all projects. Servers marked 'project-opt-in' are disabled by default — enable them in the project's .mcp.json or by providing the required credentials per project.

sonarqube._role: First-class quality gate: run before every PR merge decision via pr-health-check and pr-readiness skills. Enable per project by providing SONAR_TOKEN and SONAR_HOST_URL.
sonarqube._note: [NOT AVAILABLE] The mcp/sonarqube Docker image does not exist publicly. You need to build a custom MCP server for SonarQube integration or find a community implementation.

codecov._role: Optional: enable when coverage trend tracking is required for PR merge decisions. Used by the acceptance-validation and pr-readiness skills.
codecov._note: [NOT AVAILABLE] The mcp/codecov Docker image does not exist publicly. You need to build a custom MCP server for Codecov integration or find a community implementation.

slack._note: [VERIFY IMAGE README] Confirm required env vars and runtime args at https://github.com/chisanan232/slack-mcp-server before enabling

clickup._note: [VERIFY IMAGE README] Confirm required env vars and runtime args at https://github.com/chisanan232/clickup-mcp-server before enabling
clickup._role: Enable when CLAUDE_ISSUE_TRACKER=clickup. Only one issue_tracking provider should be active at a time.

jira._note: IMPORTANT: JIRA_USERNAME must be your Atlassian account EMAIL (e.g. user@example.com), NOT your username. JIRA_URL must be the full base URL (e.g. https://yourorg.atlassian.net). JIRA_API_TOKEN is generated at https://id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. See https://github.com/sooperset/mcp-atlassian for full documentation.
jira._role: Enable when CLAUDE_ISSUE_TRACKER=jira. Set JIRA_URL, JIRA_USERNAME, and JIRA_API_TOKEN in .env. Only one issue_tracking provider should be active at a time.

playwright._role: Used for UI acceptance testing - navigate pages, interact with elements via accessibility tree, capture snapshots. Enable for projects with a web UI.

datadog._note: [NOT AVAILABLE] The mcp/datadog Docker image does not exist publicly. You need to build a custom MCP server for Datadog integration or find a community implementation.
